name: artemis-file-upload
title: File upload
description: A dropzone that reacts to dragged files, accepts paste and browsing, validates type and size, and tracks each upload with progress, speed, pause, retry, image previews, and a rolling summary
docs: artemis-file-upload: 1 demo image is not part of the shadcn install. Download from the URLs in meta.assets into the same public/ paths, or install with the zeus-ui CLI, which copies them.
